exactness: uses backend.app.services.mesh_service functions directly with production defaults on existing point_cloud.ply

quality_gates.name: segmentation.isolated_points
quality_gates.explanation: High isolated-point ratio indicates possible background leakage or sparse segmentation.

quality_gates.name: segmentation.outliers
quality_gates.explanation: Nearest-neighbor outliers can expand PDI support and inflate volume.

quality_gates.name: segmentation.mean_density
quality_gates.explanation: Low global density increases sensitivity to voxelization.

quality_gates.name: segmentation.bbox_aspect
quality_gates.explanation: Extreme bounding-box ratios can indicate missing views or background contamination.

quality_gates.name: coverage.spatial_distribution
quality_gates.explanation: Low occupied-cell coverage suggests incomplete spatial support.

quality_gates.name: coverage.interior_holes
quality_gates.explanation: High empty-interior ratio is a proxy for large holes or missing regions.

quality_gates.name: coverage.lateral
quality_gates.explanation: Low lateral coverage can cause structured underestimation.

quality_gates.name: coverage.top
quality_gates.explanation: Low top coverage can indicate missing upper surface observations.

quality_gates.name: coverage.bottom
quality_gates.explanation: Low bottom coverage is expected in aerial capture but reduces volumetric confidence.

quality_gates.name: geometry.point_count
quality_gates.explanation: Low point count reduces estimator stability.

quality_gates.name: geometry.components
quality_gates.explanation: Many disconnected occupied components indicate fragmentation or background leakage.

quality_gates.name: geometry.spatial_consistency
quality_gates.explanation: Low dominant-component ratio indicates fragmented spatial support.
